changes.purpose: Analyze only SHA-256-validated native temporal 100% crops and rank adjacent-frame transitions using luminance histogram, edge/high-frequency energy and small translation-compensated luma error.
Machine-readable non-scoring policy: manual review required, zero automatic Visual Fidelity points, and no automatic clearing of severe aliasing/shimmering or visible LOD pop.

Capture subpixel-grazing and LOD-walk evidence from the exact already-prepared benchmark scene without rebuilding/reopening after the accepted asynchronous reflection synchronization; bind the temporal manifest to scene and reflection proof SHA-256 hashes.
Machine-readable fail-closed policy that prohibits a scene rebuild/reopen between accepted reflection synchronization and the authoritative temporal capture.
Use the prepared-scene temporal path in the authoritative packet and run still/temporal diagnostics only after sealed evidence and prepared-scene binding validation.

notes: The diagnostic analyzer first invokes ValidateLatestTemporalEvidence, so missing, altered, unsealed, wrong-size or non-pixel-exact temporal evidence is rejected before metrics are generated.
Metrics are advisory triage only: low values never clear severe_aliasing_or_shimmer or visible_lod_pop, while high values create manual review candidates rather than an automatic visual FAIL.

Static audit found that the legacy temporal CaptureAndSeal path rebuilds/reopens the benchmark and then calls RefreshRealtimeProbesImmediately, whose same-call-stack RenderProbe/IsFinishedRendering check can fail before Unity advances a frame. The authoritative Native 4K Review Packet no longer uses that legacy path.

The new prepared temporal path requires the already-open saved benchmark scene, validates the asynchronous reflection completion receipt/wait proof, performs no build/apply/open calls, captures both required sequences, verifies the persisted scene SHA is unchanged, reuses the established pixel-exact temporal validator, and writes a binding receipt covering scene/temporal/reflection hashes.
No runtime screenshots, Unity compile artifact or Captures4K/Temporal4K evidence was available during this source-side run.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability: once a runner exists, temporal frames now come from the same prepared, reflection-synchronized benchmark state as the still packet, then suspicious adjacent-frame transitions are surfaced first for 100%-pixel review.

Critical severe aliasing/shimmering and visible LOD pop: the new path strengthens evidence provenance and review efficiency but deliberately cannot clear or assert either critical defect without manual inspection of sealed native frames.

Lighting/reflections evidence integrity: temporal evidence is SHA-256-bound to the accepted reflection completion receipt and later-Editor-update wait proof instead of relying on a same-call-stack refresh after a scene rebuild.
Evidence integrity: diagnostics are bound to validated native temporal crops and the prepared temporal binding records that no scene rebuild/reopen occurred in the authoritative path.
Real-time quality iteration: ranked transition pairs should make subsequent corrective work target the largest observed temporal deduction instead of speculative scene expansion.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile and native 3840x2160 execution. At first availability, run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet; verify the prepared temporal binding is produced, inspect all ranked temporal candidates and full sequences at 100%, then fix the largest actual deduction or any critical defect instead of adding speculative detail.
